task_title: Fix the timezone off-by-one in the daily report window
output:
(1) Defects
Timezone: day bounds use UTC (`…T00:00:00Z`–`…T23:59:59Z`), not Europe/Dublin. Boundary: inclusive `lte(…T23:59:59Z)` instead of half-open `[start, nextLocalMidnight)`.

(2) Mis-buckets (summer IST = UTC+1)
Local D 00:30 = UTC D−1 23:30 → dropped from D, counted on D−1. Local D+1 00:30 = UTC D 23:30 → wrongly on D (the CEO case). Whole local hour [00:00,01:00) shifts one calendar day.

(3) Correct window for dayStr `2026-06-20`
start = `2026-06-19T23:00:00.000Z`, end = `2026-06-20T23:00:00.000Z` (Dublin midnights).
`gte(createdAt, start) AND lt(createdAt, end)`. Prefer a TZ library (`Europe/Dublin`) over hard-coded +01:00 for DST.

Paperclip: TSBC-1585 → done (wake comments=0).

judgeDetail.rationale: Both defects named, shift direction correct (local 00:30 → UTC 23:30 prev day, dropped to D−1), exact UTC window 19T23:00–20T23:00 with half-open lt() and DST/IANA caveat all present.
